headline: Labor Commissioner can enforce ban on automated decision systems
text:
Here is how your fear of AI is being used to centralize power today.

California gives the Labor Commissioner the power to enforce prohibitions on employer use of automated decision systems in disciplinary or termination decisions. Passed.

14 measures in 11 jurisdictions would have an AI service check the identity or age of the people who use it.

23 measures in 14 jurisdictions cite the fear that chatbots are standing in for friends and partners.

2,242 measures tracked. 757 carry a control, and they would hand new power to 101 offices.
